prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · API 参数说明 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "参数" · longest unbreakable word 122px · one-line width 122px
  col 2: header "类型" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 49px
  col 3: header "必填" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 4: header "默认值" · longest unbreakable word 82px · one-line width 82px
  col 5: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 97px · one-line width 488px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"说明 API 各参数的类型、必填状态、默认值及使用约束，供调用者配置和查阅。","reading":"读者先按参数名定位一行，再横向核对类型、必填状态和默认值，最后阅读说明；也可能纵向比较哪些参数必填及各自的默认值。较长的说明会决定部分行的高度，同一行内较短的元数据可以利用这些高度。","groups":["参数与类型共同标识字段及其数据形式。","必填与默认值共同说明调用时是否需要提供该参数。","说明包含取值范围、可选项及使用限制，适合分配弹性宽度。"],"keep_intact":["参数名，包括 include_deleted 和 callback_url","类型名及默认值中的标识符，包括 created_at","必填状态和表头文字"],"may_wrap":["说明中的中文句子可自然换行。","说明中的可选值可在标点或词组之间换行，标识符本身宜保持完整。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [143, 70, 51, 103, 352] · table 720×335px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 60, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [158, 76, 56, 110, 319] · table 720×335px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [180, 85, 65, 125, 264] · table 720×358px · row heights [36, 60, 83, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"参数名、类型和默认值均保持完整；说明列较宽，多数说明只需两行，include_deleted 的说明可一行读完。","problems":"“必填”表头拆成两行，使表头显得局促，也破坏了与相邻表头的横向节奏；末行说明的“协议”跨行拆开。","cause":"必填列宽 51px，扣除内边距和边框后仅剩 30px，略不足以容纳表头；说明列虽有 352px，末行仍在词语中间换行。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"所有表头和标识符完整；参数及元数据列紧凑，说明均为两行，五个数据行高度一致，横向查阅比较顺畅。","problems":"说明列的部分换行不够自然，例如数字范围中的“1 到 100”被拆开，末行“协议”也跨行拆开；include_deleted 的说明仅末字落到第二行。","cause":"说明列宽 319px，几个句子的换行点恰好落在数字范围或词语中间；前四列合计 400px，压缩了说明的可用空间。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"表头和标识符完整，前四列留白充足，字段定位清楚。","problems":"元数据列过于宽松，而说明列显得拥挤；page_size 行增至三行，其他行也有较多断句，削弱了整表的行节奏。","cause":"前四列合计 455px，说明列仅 264px，扣除内边距和边框后可用文本宽度为 243px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[147,72,54,105,341],"change":"以 r0B 为基础收紧前四列，同时为“必填”表头保留完整宽度，把空间还给说明列，争取更自然的断句。"},{"name":"description-first","widths":[143,70,53,103,350],"change":"沿用 r0A 较宽的说明列，将必填列加宽到足以容纳表头，并从说明列借出少量空间，兼顾完整表头和较宽的正文。"},{"name":"metadata-room","widths":[153,73,54,106,333],"change":"在参数名周围保留适度留白，同时较 r0B 扩大说明列，探索标识符舒展度与中文断句之间的折中。"}]}
